description: Na₅B(SO₄)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.72 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.77 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.65 Å. B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-46°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.58 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.59 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 35°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.61 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-60°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.59 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one S atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one B and one S atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one B, and one S atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one B, and one S atom.
